answer: Sponsorship gates trellis: a juniper is admitted only after three sponsors stake willow behind it, and the kth juniper requires k willow per sponsor, read from the live juniper count at commit. No sponsor may back two juniper, and sponsors must be unrelated in funding and attestation history, so a farm of a thousand juniper needs 3,000 distinct sponsors and burns 1,501,500 willow, each head dearer than the last.
